issues.title: Service description and use-case scope don't match the actual TalentFlow pilot
issues.planned_action: Correct the 'Basic Service' definition (currently describes general-legal-research functionality) and add a scope clause in Section 3.1 tying use to the two approved order-form workflows, with expansion requiring separate written agreement.

issues.title: No restriction against autonomous employment decisions / no human-review requirement
issues.planned_action: Add language in Section 3.1 confirming Service outputs are decision-support only and that autonomous hiring/comp/promotion/termination decisions require human review.

issues.title: No Training clause doesn't bar sale/sharing of candidate data and only 'permits' (not contractually binds) subprocessors
issues.planned_action: Strengthen Section 11.7 to prohibit selling, sharing, or using Customer Content/Data outside the Service, and to contractually bind subprocessors rather than merely 'not permit' them.

issues.title: Liability cap has no carve-out for confidentiality, data-security, or no-training breaches
issues.planned_action: Add carve-outs to Section 10.2's liability cap for breach of Section 11.5 (Confidentiality), Section 11.7 (No Training), and Personal Data Breaches.

issues.title: Confidentiality clause has no standard-of-care requirement
issues.planned_action: Insert a standard-of-care sentence into Section 11.5 (at least the same care as the receiving party's own similarly sensitive information, never less than reasonable care).

issues.title: Personal Data Breach notice standard is an unbounded 'without undue delay' with no outer limit
issues.planned_action: Add a concrete outer bound (24 hours) to the DPA's breach-notification timing in Section 3.6.

issues.title: Vendor can unilaterally downgrade Customer's audit right to a self-selected summary
issues.planned_action: Condition the audit-to-summary substitution in DPA Section 3.7 on Customer's agreement rather than leaving it to AgentCo's unilateral election.
